text:
Sophie L: Heads-up — customer reported they can no longer open compliance/audit logs in the Console. Happens after their SSO re-provisioning this morning. Getting a 403 in the UI.
Sophie L: Error shown in UI: `You do not have permission to view audit logs (read_access_required)`
Sophie L: Customer org: acme-health-prod. Tenant is on Dedicated in eu-west-1. They say this used to work yesterday.
Sophie L: Ticket created: CS-7219. Incident bot created ticket #CS-7219 (link: https://zendesk.example/CS-7219) :rotating_light:
Marco R: Can you paste the exact API error from the backend logs? 403 could be entitlement or missing token scope.
Sophie L: Pasting the proxied API response we see from the console service:
Sophie L: ```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "message": "missing_scope:compliance.logs.read",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d"
}
```
Sophie L: Also grabbed the Console-side header used when calling /v1/audit/logs:
Sophie L: ```
Authorization: Bearer mF_9.B5f-4.1Jq
X-Sso-Provider: okta
X-Org-Id: org_acme_health_prod
```
Olga C: This screams SSO role -> Redwood entitlement mapping got dropped during their IdP reprovisioning. Okta may have stopped sending the role claim or the claim name changed.
Olga C: @Marco R can you check the most recent SSO events for that org? Specifically looking for missing `roles` or `entitlements` claim in the SAML/OIDC assertion.
Marco R: On it. Querying oncall logs for org_acme_health_prod SSO events now.
deploy-bot: auth-audit: new SSO assertion received for org_acme_health_prod at 2026-02-12T09:22:11Z
Marco R: Found the assertion. The OIDC token for that user does not include `entitlements` nor the `roles` array — only `email` and `sub`. Looks like the Okta app mapping for our custom claim `redwood_entitlements` was removed.
Sophie L: Customer says they re-mapped groups on their side earlier today. They may have accidentally removed the custom claim after a group rename.
Olga C: If the token lacks the entitlement claim our auth layer will not attach `compliance.logs.read` scope to the session. We need the IdP to include either `redwood_entitlements: ["compliance.logs.read"]` or ensure the role mapped to that entitlement is present in the claim.
Sophie L: Repro steps for support/engineering to validate quickly:
Sophie L: 1) Have a user sign in via the customer's Okta (or fetch an id_token via their OIDC setup).
Sophie L: 2) Curl the audit logs endpoint using the session cookie or Authorization header from the console call and observe response.
Sophie L: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <id_token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?org=org_acme_health_prod
```
Sophie L: Expected: 200 + logs. Observed: 403 + JSON above.
Marco R: I can repro with a token stripped of entitlements — returning 403 with `missing_scope:compliance.logs.read` as Sophie pasted.
Marco R: Short-term mitigation: Support can add a temporary org-level entitlement mapping on the control plane for this customer (manual grant) so their users regain read access while IdP mapping is fixed. But that requires an org admin approval. Should we do that?
Olga C: We must ensure audit retention entitlements are not loosened. This is strictly a read access problem; don't change retention settings. If we grant manual read permission, log the action in admin audit and timebox it.
Sophie L: Customer is asking for immediate access — they've got compliance obligations. I'll push for org admin sign-off to accept a temporary entitlement grant; asking legal to approve timebox 48h.
Marco R: Steps I'll take now: 1) Open a short-lived control-plane entitlement grant for org_acme_health_prod with `compliance.logs.read` for 48h, 2) add audit note linking to CS-7219, 3) message you when done.
Marco R: Done — control-plane change queued. Request id cp_req_9823. Please confirm once customer can access.
Sophie L: Sent instructions to customer to sign out/in and retry. Also asked them to restore the `redwood_entitlements` claim in Okta mappings for long-term fix.
Sophie L: Customer confirmed — they can see logs now. :white_check_mark: 
Sophie L: They will push Okta claim fix by EOD and confirm. I'll keep ticket open until we see a successful assertion with entitlements in logs and then remove the temporary grant.
Olga C: Follow-up items for Product/Security: we should add a more descriptive UI message for missing entitlement (include hint: "your identity provider is not sending required claims") and a one-click troubleshooting link to the SSO mapping docs.
Marco R: I'll file a GH task: RED-PLT-1589 to add the UI hint + docs link.
Sophie L: Adding final note to CS ticket: temporary entitlement granted cp_req_9823, customer re-enabled access, root cause: IdP mapping removed `redwood_entitlements` claim. Will close after confirmation of permanent fix.
compliance-bot: automated: admin-audit entry created for cp_req_9823 by Marco R (link)
Sophie L: Thanks all. Closing loop once Okta claim is back in place. :pray:
